name: 01841 · Lawrence, MA
findings: ZIP 01841 (Lawrence) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01841 (Lawrence) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 01841 (Lawrence) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 32% of the typical level).
